features: Auto-sensing HB Series Lenses: HERO13 Black supports HB series lenses that allow you to instantly configure your camera for a variety of special shots. The Ultra Wide Lens Mod is the ultimate POV lens for action-packed scenes and epic landscapes.

Best-in-class 5.3K video: 5.3K video delivers stunning picture quality with 91% higher resolution than 4K and an incredible 665% over 1080p. HERO13 Black captures the action with crisp detail and demanding image quality so any photo with any lens looks amazing. 5.3K video also lets you take stunning photos up to 24.7MP of your footage with the GoPro Quik app.

Burst Slo-Mo: HERO13 Black features our slowest slo-mo with the ability to record video clips with the action slowed up to 13 times the normal speed. You'll also be able to shoot short 4x clips with our highest resolution 5.3K video to capture epic details you could never see with the naked eye.

HEAVY DUTY + WATER RESISTANT TO 10M (33FT): HERO13 Black was designed to take a beating. It's ready to capture the fun on any adventure, whether you're ripping mud, snow, or water (up to 10 meters). A water repellent lens cover even helps remove glare from lens and other artifacts to help keep your photos and videos clear.
Includes: HERO13 Black Camera, Dual Battery Charger, 3 Enduro Batteries, 1 Curved Adhesive Mount, 64GB SanDisk MicroSD Card, Mounting Buckle + Thumb Screw, 2 USB-C Cable, Camera Case
